Quick computational sanity checks from my side (ran the sim in kb-token-sim.csv):

Notes:
- Using Emma's median 880 tokens/roundtrip and the pricing Tessa outlined, the blended cost per session is ~$0.49. That maps to ~2.04 sessions per $1.00.
- If cache hit improves from 60% -> 72% (your nominal), cost per session drops to ~$0.36 (~2.77 sessions/$).
- Batching at a 10 ms window increases throughput per GPU by ~14% on our measurements; per-token cost delta is marginal (~-4%) but p99 latency shows a ~6–8% shift depending on sequence length.

Critical ops caveat: prefix cache behavior matters. If your traffic has high long-tail freshness (many unique prefixes per user), effective hit rate can collapse — that changes the economics materially. Recommend the 70–85% sim Emma offered.

Action items I can own: run a 2-hour synthetic prefetched KV sim with your sample traffic and return a short CSV of hit-rate vs p99 vs tokens/$ by 12/11.
